question: Which of the following hills and their region are correctly matched?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Javadi hills - Eastern ghats**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Javadi Hills**

 
 
• **​**The** Javadhu Hills**, also known as **Jawadhi** or Jawadhu Hills, are an extension of the **Eastern Ghats** that are scattered across portions of **Tirupattur** (formerly part of Vellore District) and Tiruvannamalai districts in the **northern** section of **Tamil Nadu** state in southeastern India.
 
• **Tirupattur **and **Tiruvannamalai** districts are divided by this **mountain**.
 
• The districts of Tirupattur and Tiruvannamalai are located on opposite sides of this mountain range, respectively.
 
• On the northwestern side are the cities of Tirupattur, **Vaniyambadi**, and **Ambur** from the Tirupattur district, and on the south-eastern side are **Chengam **and Polur from the **Tiruvannamalai district**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The mountains are made of bluish-gray granite with peaks that are **3,800–4,000** feet high (1,300–1,350 m).
 
• The **Cheyyar **and **Agaram **rivers, tributaries of the Palar, divide them into eastern and western sections, with each being around 50 miles (80 km) wide and** 20 **miles** (32 km)** long.
 
• "The** Jawadhi range**, in contrast to the Barahmahal hills to the **west**, is covered in vegetation all the way up to its **highest **point. As **dusk **falls, the entire range takes on a purple hue resembling a **heather** bloom.
 
• A **silvery **cascade that shines brightly in the **evening **sun may be seen beyond **Bommaikuppam **when looking from **Tirupatur**.
